name: AI Content Assistant
project_description: AI Content Assistant generates complete, unpublished Drupal nodes from a short text prompt. It inspects the target content type's field schema — node fields plus any Paragraphs reference fields and their sub-paragraphs — builds a schema-aware system prompt, asks the configured AI (drupal/ai) chat provider to return structured JSON, and maps that JSON back onto real entity values: node fields, nested paragraphs, entity references (validated against the field's selection handler), links (URI-scheme filtered), formatted text (basic_html/plain_text), and images generated on the fly via a text_to_image provider. A "Generate with AI" link is added to /node/add and a form lives at /node/add/ai-generate. Administrators can annotate each content type with a free-form description that is fed to the AI for better results. An optional submodule (ai_content_assistant_mcp) exposes the same capability as Model Context Protocol tools so AI clients such as Claude can plan and create draft content directly.
